title: A brief per kind of help: Home reads what an analysis, a report, a business question or advice needs, asks only what matters, and shows what it understood
request: The owner's goal: Home understands people who want data analysis, data preparation, BI and reports, business answers or advice, not only models, and routes them; continue the Home plan with H4.
spec: Package H4 of the Home plan: TRACK_FIELDS with why, default and where options come from; a field is asked only when unknown with no safe default; a per-track budget; every question has a Not sure button that records the default and never erases what was known; the prediction track unchanged; median questions per request at most 3 on H1 dev.
plan: Write the brief readers from the H1 dev requests in English and Persian, precision first (a field left unknown costs a question; a wrong one misleads).
Wire the brief into Home: read on the request, again when data arrives, ask only what matters, take answers by code, show a sheet the person can correct.
Measure on H1 dev with the rules, review adversarially, fix, measure again.

decisions.decision: A value that names a column the table does not have is refused and said, never taken.
decisions.why: The H1 trap: 'the average lifetime_spend' on a table with no such column must not become the measure.

decisions.decision: An analysis's question stays its default (the request as written) instead of a reading.
decisions.why: Reading the whole sentence as a field carried a missing column back in and added nothing.

decisions.decision: A message answers an open brief question only when it is Not sure, a button, or a short reply naming no other kind of help.
decisions.why: The review: 'actually I want to predict churn' was stored as the measure.

decisions.decision: Only an outright 'an analysis of' or 'analyse my...' is a strong analysis signal.
decisions.why: 'Explore the data and find who churns' is a prediction; explore, profile, summarize and statistics are said in passing.

change: draft/brief.py (TRACK_FIELDS, BUDGET, English and Persian patterns, read with the missing-column refusal, fill, asks, options, answered); draft/chat.py (open_brief, ask_brief, answers_brief, brief_answer, set_brief with its correction kept, a read_brief step); draft/intent.py and draft/lang.py (analysis signals, intent_rules_v2); ledger/capture.py reads the rules' version; draft/api.py POST /api/drafts/{id}/brief; home.html (the sheet with its Change control); agent_eval/home --lang.

findings.defect: Plainly asked analyses fell to the prediction default.
findings.scenario: 'I want an analysis of my tickets', 'Analyse my support tickets' and 'summarize my ticket data' read as predictions.
findings.cause: No strong English signal for an analysis asked outright.
findings.fix: An outright 'an analysis of' or 'analyse my...' is strong; Persian 'تحلیل' and 'آمار' too.

findings.defect: Short brief values were not valid quotes.
findings.scenario: 19 bad quotes on H1 dev: 'region', 'weekly' and 'daily' are one short word.
findings.cause: The quote was the value itself.
findings.fix: A short value is quoted with its neighbours ('per region').

findings.defect: A missing column came back through a reading made before the data arrived.
findings.scenario: d-a6: 'average lifetime_spend' was read at the start and kept after the table showed no such column.
findings.cause: A known field was never replaced.
findings.fix: A rules reading of a missing column is withdrawn when the data arrives; a person's words never are.

findings.defect: New analysis signals took prediction requests off the prediction track.
findings.scenario: 'I want to explore the data and find which customers churn' read as an analysis.
findings.cause: explore, profile, summarize and statistics weighed 3.
findings.fix: They weigh 2; only an analysis asked outright weighs 3.

findings.defect: Any message became the open brief question's answer.
findings.scenario: 'Actually I want to predict which customers will churn next month' was stored as the measure; a request for synthetic data too.
findings.cause: reply() answered the brief question first and returned.
findings.fix: Only Not sure, a button or a short reply naming no other kind of help; anything else closes the question and takes the normal path.

findings.defect: A sheet edit was overwritten by the next message.
findings.scenario: The measure set on the sheet became 'and split it by region please'.
findings.cause: set_brief left the open question on that field open.
findings.fix: The sheet answers the open question on its field.

findings.defect: Save could store one field's text in another field.
findings.scenario: With two editors open, Save on Period read the Measure editor's text.
findings.cause: Every editor had the same id and Save read the first.
findings.fix: Save reads its own row's input; a status event never redraws under the person's typing.

findings.defect: Ordinary words were read as fields.
findings.scenario: 'by the end of the month' gave breakdown 'end'; 'I may want' gave period 'may'; 'dashboard for my boss' gave kpis 'my boss'; 'only interested in' gave a filter.
findings.fix: Those words excluded, month names only after a time word or before a year, 'for' out of the kpis pattern, the 'every X has' grain pattern dropped.

measurements.name: Home on the H1 dev requests, rules alone, after H4 (HOME-009)
measurements.gate: the plan's done-when: median questions at most 3; no brief field wrong
measurements.result: Track 1.0 in every language; fields right 65 (6 before H4), wrong 0, missed 13; bad quotes 0, made-up columns 0; traps 5 of 6 (the missing column now passes); median questions 0
limits: the brief patterns were written from these dev requests, so dev overstates
the suite answers every question 'not sure', so free-text answers are tested in the unit tests, not here
the model arm is measured separately

measurements.name: Home with the product's model on the English H1 dev requests (HOME-008)
measurements.gate: home_gate_v1's checks read on this arm: no bad quote, no uncited number, no wrong field
measurements.result: Model arm: kind of help right on all English dev requests, fields right 49, wrong 0, bad quotes 0, uncited numbers 0; rules alone 45 right, 0 wrong; the model asked once with no checks: 5 fields wrong
limits: English only (the owner's choice for live runs)
one run on dev requests; the sealed set runs once at the end of the plan
the answers themselves (the exits) come in the next packages

outcome: Home now understands, per kind of help, what the person asked for, asks only what matters with a Not sure button, and shows what it understood on a sheet the person can correct; every reading, answer and correction is kept with its source.
lessons: A word can be a signal and a passing remark at once: weigh what the person asks for, not what they mention.
An open question must not swallow the next message; read whether the message answers it first.
risks: Brief patterns are written by one model from dev requests; real people will phrase things the patterns miss (then Home asks, or the field stays unknown).
